issues.title: [Bug]: BinaryVector HAMMING search silently ignores top-level group_by_fields instead of rejecting or grouping
issues.excerpt: ### Is there an existing issue for this? - [x] I have searched the existing issues ### Environment ### Current Behavior `BinaryVector` search with HAMMING accepts the top-level search parameter `group_by_fields`, but it neither rejects the request nor applies group-by semantics. When searching with: Milvus returns ordinary Hamming Top-k results instead of one best result per group. Actual result: ids = [1, 2, 4, 3] groups = [1, 1, 2, 2] id=1 and id=2 both belong to group 1, so `group_by_fields` appears to be silently ignored. The same result is returned after applying the same XOR mask to both the query vector and all stored binary vectors: base: ([1, 2, 4, 3], ...) xor : ([1, 2, 4, 3], ...)

issues.title: Exact Euclid search collapses distinct tiny vectors to zero distance in Qdrant 1.19.1
issues.excerpt: ## Current Behavior Exact Euclid search (`params.exact=true`) with points `id1=[1e-25, 0]`, `id2=[0, 0]` and query `[1e-25, 0]` returns The **zero vector** (true distance `1e-25` from the query) ranks *before* the **exact self-match** (true distance `0`), and the non-self score is collapsed to `0.0`. Expected: `[(1, 0.0), (2, 1e-25)]`.
